releaseNotes: Complete learner account flow: no Firebase configuration is ever requested from new users or new devices
Email registration now sends a Firebase email-verification link and cloud sync waits until verification is complete
Email sign-in detects unverified accounts and provides Verify, Resend and I have verified controls
Forgot password and signed-in Reset password send secure Firebase password-reset emails
New email accounts require password confirmation and at least 8 characters
Google sign-in remains available and verified Google accounts can sync immediately
Guest mode remains local-only; recordings remain local to each device
All v9 practice history/recall schedules and v8 Hide English/Hide Hindi recall features are retained
